title: Dark Matter Constraints from Small-Scale Cosmic Structure
comment: 73 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables; submitted to Reviews of Modern Physics; comments welcome
summary: Small-scale cosmic structure provides a powerful test of the fundamental nature of dark matter (DM). A wide range of DM models impact matter clustering on small scales, including warm, fuzzy, and (self-)interacting DM. In these scenarios, DM physics such as free-streaming, wave interference, and self/Standard Model interactions alter the abundance and internal structure of DM halos. Cosmological and astrophysical probes of nonlinear structure---including dwarf galaxies, strong lensing, the Lyman-$α$ forest, stellar streams, and high-redshift galaxies---are therefore sensitive to these effects. Here, we review DM constraints provided by small-scale structure, focusing on observables that probe scales smaller than $\sim 1~\mathrm{Mpc}$, which define the frontier of current measurements. We summarize how these constraints have been translated to limits on microphysical DM models, and we discuss key modeling uncertainties and observational systematics. Finally, we highlight the growing importance of probe combination and simulation-based inference for this field, and we overview upcoming observational facilities that will sharpen small-scale structure tests of DM physics.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 小尺度宇宙结构为暗物质（DM）的基本性质提供了强有力的检验。广泛的暗物质模型会影响小尺度上的物质成团性，包括暖暗物质、模糊暗物质和（自）相互作用暗物质。在这些情景中，暗物质物理如自由流、波干涉以及自相互作用/标准模型相互作用会改变暗物质晕的丰度和内部结构。非线性结构的宇宙学和天体物理学探针——包括矮星系、强引力透镜、莱曼α森林、恒星流和高红移星系——因此对这些效应敏感。在此，我们回顾了小尺度结构提供的暗物质约束，重点关注探测尺度小于约1兆秒差距（Mpc）的可观测量，这定义了当前测量的前沿。我们总结了这些约束如何转化为对微观暗物质模型的限制，并讨论了关键的建模不确定性和观测系统学。最后，我们强调了探针组合和基于模拟的推断在该领域中日益增长的重要性，并概述了即将投入使用的观测设施，这些设施将加强小尺度结构对暗物质物理的检验。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，结论指出未来的观测设施将进一步提升小尺度结构对暗物质物理的测试能力，探针联合分析是推动该领域发展的关键方向。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Wavenumber and mass scales probed by small–scale cosmic structure observables as a function of redshift. Filled boxes show probes with current data, and unfilled boxes show future datasets. The thick black dashed line shows the wavenumber where structure formation becomes nonlinear, \(k_{{nl}}(z)\) , via Equation 3 . We define small-scale structure as the gold shaded region with \(k>k_{{nl}}\) ; this review focuses on probes of sub-Mpc scales, corresponding to \(k\gtrsim 6~{Mpc}^{-1}\) . The thin dotted black line, \(M_{dark}(z)\) , shows a conservative lower limit on the least massive halo to host a luminous galaxy, and the gray shaded region indicates the theoretical uncertainty on this lower limit [ 73 , 506 ] . Wavenumbers are associated with peak halo masses via Equation 5 . Stellar streams and dwarf galaxies are extended in \(z\) for visual clarity. Adapted from Sabti et al. [ 629 ] and Boddy et al. [ 94 ] , with the addition of LRG clustering [ 603 ] .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：小尺度宇宙结构观测所探测的波数和质量尺度随红移的变化。填充框表示当前数据可探测的探针，未填充框表示未来数据集。粗黑虚线表示结构形成变为非线性的波数，\(k_{{nl}}(z)\)，通过方程3计算。我们将小尺度结构定义为金色阴影区域，其中\(k>k_{{nl}}\)；本综述聚焦于亚兆秒差距尺度的探针，对应于\(k\gtrsim 6~{Mpc}^{-1}\)。细点黑线\(M_{dark}(z)\)表示能够承载发光星系的最小质量晕的保守下限，灰色阴影区域表示该下限的理论不确定性[73, 506]。波数与峰值晕质量通过方程5关联。恒星流和矮星系在\(z\)方向上延伸以增强视觉清晰度。改编自Sabti等人[629]和Boddy等人[94]，并添加了LRG成团性数据[603]。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Observational probes of small-scale structure (first column) and associated redshift (second column), wavenumber (third column), and halo mass (fourth column) ranges. Wavenumbers and halo masses are related via Equation 5 ; however, note that certain observables (e.g., the Lyman- \(\alpha\) forest) do not probe collapsed objects. The small-scale structure regime corresponds to \(k\gtrsim 0.2\,{Mpc}^{-1}\) at \(z=0\) .
figures.caption_zh: 表1：小尺度结构的观测探针（第一列）及其对应的红移（第二列）、波数（第三列）和晕质量（第四列）范围。波数和晕质量通过方程5关联；但需注意，某些观测（如莱曼α森林）并不探测坍缩天体。小尺度结构区域对应于\(z=0\)时的\(k\gtrsim 0.2\,{Mpc}^{-1}\)。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Dimensionless linear matter power spectrum, \(\Delta^{2}(k)\) , extrapolated linearly to \(z=0\) , as a function of wavenumber. Small-scale structure probes the regime where \(\Delta^{2}(k)>1\) in CDM, corresponding to \(k>k_{{nl}}=0.2~{Mpc}^{-1}\) at \(z=0\) (gold shaded region). The dashed vertical line shows \(k_{{nl}}\) . The dotted vertical line shows an estimate for the minimum mass of luminous halos at \(z=0\) , and the gray shaded region indicates the theoretical uncertainty on this lower limit. Error bars show \(P(k)\) constraints from Chabanier et al. [ 146 ] , with the addition of high- \(z\) galaxy UV luminosity function measurements from Sabti et al. [ 629 ] , and horizontal lines show wavenumber ranges corresponding to the probes from Figure 1 . Power spectrum predictions are shown for the following DM models: CDM (black), WDM (red; \(m_{{WDM}}=3.5~{keV}\) using the Vogel and Abazajian [ 728 ] transfer function), FDM (purple; \(m_{{FDM}}=10^{-21}~{eV}\) using the Passaglia and Hu [ 572 ] transfer function), IDM (blue; DM–proton scattering with \(\sigma_{0}=10^{-22}~{cm}^{2}\) and \(\sigma\sim v^{4}\) , using the Boddy and Gluscevic [ 92 ] transfer function), and a phenomenological model with enhanced power (green; Gaussian bump with \(k_{0}=41.8~{Mpc}^{-1}\) , \(A=2\) , and \(\sigma_{k}=0.5\) using the transfer function from Tkachev et al. 701 and parameters from Nadler et al. 514 ). Adapted from Bechtol et al. [ 71 ] .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：无量纲线性物质功率谱\(\Delta^{2}(k)\)，线性外推至\(z=0\)，作为波数的函数。小尺度结构探测CDM中\(\Delta^{2}(k)>1\)的区域，对应于\(z=0\)时的\(k>k_{{nl}}=0.2~{Mpc}^{-1}\)（金色阴影区域）。虚线垂直线表示\(k_{{nl}}\)。点线垂直线表示\(z=0\)时发光晕的最小质量估计，灰色阴影区域表示该下限的理论不确定性。误差棒显示来自Chabanier等人[146]的\(P(k)\)约束，并添加了Sabti等人[629]的高红移星系紫外光度函数测量，水平线表示图1中探针对应的波数范围。功率谱预测针对以下暗物质模型：CDM（黑色）、WDM（红色；\(m_{{WDM}}=3.5~{keV}\)，使用Vogel和Abazajian [728]的传递函数）、FDM（紫色；\(m_{{FDM}}=10^{-21}~{eV}\)，使用Passaglia和Hu [572]的传递函数）、IDM（蓝色；DM-质子散射，\(\sigma_{0}=10^{-22}~{cm}^{2}\)且\(\sigma\sim v^{4}\)，使用Boddy和Gluscevic [92]的传递函数），以及一个具有增强功率的现象学模型（绿色；高斯凸起，\(k_{0}=41.8~{Mpc}^{-1}\)，\(A=2\)，\(\sigma_{k}=0.5\)，使用Tkachev等人701的传递函数和Nadler等人514的参数）。改编自Bechtol等人[71]。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Summary of lower limits on the thermal-relic WDM mass as a function of publication date. Constraints are colored by analyses of the Lyman- \(\alpha\) forest (gray), dwarf galaxies (dark blue for limits from abundances and blue for limits from profiles), strong gravitational lensing (red for gravitational imaging and light red for flux ratio anomalies), high- \(z\) galaxies (purple), stellar streams (green), and combinations of small-scale structure probes (black). Results that report both a fiducial and optimistic limit are shown by opaque arrows (placed at the fiducial constraint with lower \(m_{{WDM}}\) ) connected to transparent arrows (placed at the more optimistic limit). The dark shaded region shows the aggregate WDM limit from small-scale structure over time, based on the fiducial bounds from all individual probes; the light region shows the cumulative bound based on the optimistic limits and including probe combination results. See Appendix A for references to and statistical interpretations of these results.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：热遗迹WDM质量下限随发表日期的总结。约束按分析类型着色：莱曼α森林（灰色）、矮星系（深蓝色表示丰度限制，蓝色表示轮廓限制）、强引力透镜（红色表示引力成像，浅红色表示通量比异常）、高红移星系（紫色）、恒星流（绿色）以及小尺度结构探针组合（黑色）。同时报告基准和乐观限制的结果用不透明箭头（位于基准约束，对应较低的\(m_{{WDM}}\)）连接透明箭头（位于更乐观的限制）表示。深色阴影区域显示小尺度结构随时间的综合WDM限制，基于所有单个探针的基准界限；浅色区域显示基于乐观限制并包括探针组合结果的累积界限。参见附录A以获取这些结果的参考文献和统计解释。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Summary of constraints on the FDM cosmic energy density \(\Omega_{{FDM}}\) as a function of the FDM particle mass \(m_{{FDM}}\) , with the equivalent FDM Jeans suppression wavelength \(\lambda_{{J}}\) shown at the top. Constraints are shown as shaded areas from analyses of dwarf galaxy abundances (MW SHMF; blue, from Crumrine et al. 177 ), individual dwarf galaxy dynamics (Leo-II dwarf profile; green, from Zimmermann et al. 798 ), FDM dynamical heating in ultra-compact dwarf galaxies (Eridanus-II, red-purple, from Marsh and Niemeyer 466 ; Segue-I, gold, from Dalal and Kravtsov 185 ), the Lyman- \(\alpha\) forest (Ly- \(\alpha\) f; gray, from Kobayashi et al. 394 , Rogers and Peiris 617 ), the high- \(z\) galaxy UV luminosity function (UVLF, purple, from Winch et al. 761 ), galaxy weak lensing (WL; lighter blue, from Dentler et al. 202 ) and black hole superradiance (BHSR; bright purple, from Mehta et al. 473 ). Forecast sensitivities are shown as solid lines from future analyses of CMB lensing (CMB-S4; brown, from Dvorkin et al. 239 ), galaxy weak lensing (LSST Y1, labeled WL; lighter blue, from Preston et al. 594 ), 21-cm intensity mapping (SKA; navy blue, from Bauer et al. 67 ), CMB kinetic Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect (CMB-S4, labeled CMB-kSZ; teal, from Farren et al. 262 ) and the Lyman- \(\alpha\) forest (ELTs, labeled Ly- \(\alpha\) f; gray, from Grin et al. 318 ). A theoretically-preferred parameter range is shown between the black dashed lines where the axion decay constant \(f_{{a}}\) is at the grand unified scale (GUT-scale FDM; Marsh 463 ). The density at which FDM forms all the dark matter is indicated by the white dashed line. The code to make this figure is maintained (and updated) at https://github.com/keirkwame/DarkMatterLimits .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：FDM宇宙能量密度\(\Omega_{{FDM}}\)作为FDM粒子质量\(m_{{FDM}}\)函数的约束总结，顶部显示等效的FDM金斯抑制波长\(\lambda_{{J}}\)。约束以阴影区域显示，来自矮星系丰度分析（MW SHMF；蓝色，来自Crumrine等人177）、单个矮星系动力学（Leo-II矮星系轮廓；绿色，来自Zimmermann等人798）、超致密矮星系中的FDM动力学加热（Eridanus-II，红紫色，来自Marsh和Niemeyer 466；Segue-I，金色，来自Dalal和Kravtsov 185）、莱曼α森林（Ly-\(\alpha\) f；灰色，来自Kobayashi等人394，Rogers和Peiris 617）、高红移星系紫外光度函数（UVLF，紫色，来自Winch等人761）、星系弱引力透镜（WL；浅蓝色，来自Dentler等人202）和黑洞超辐射（BHSR；亮紫色，来自Mehta等人473）。预测灵敏度以实线显示，来自未来CMB透镜分析（CMB-S4；棕色，来自Dvorkin等人239）、星系弱引力透镜（LSST Y1，标记为WL；浅蓝色，来自Preston等人594）、21厘米强度映射（SKA；海军蓝，来自Bauer等人67）、CMB动力学Sunyaev-Zeldovich效应（CMB-S4，标记为CMB-kSZ；青色，来自Farren等人262）和莱曼α森林（ELTs，标记为Ly-\(\alpha\) f；灰色，来自Grin等人318）。理论上偏好的参数范围显示在黑色虚线之间，其中轴子衰变常数\(f_{{a}}\)处于大统一尺度（GUT尺度FDM；Marsh 463）。FDM形成所有暗物质的密度由白色虚线表示。生成此图的代码维护（并更新）于https://github.com/keirkwame/DarkMatterLimits。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Representative constraints on the velocity-independent DM–nucleon scattering cross section as a function of the DM particle mass. Upper limits from small-scale structure are shown by the gold shaded region, including limits from high- \(z\) galaxies (purple; Lazare et al. 413 ), dwarf galaxies (blue; Nadler et al. 521 ), and the Lyman- \(\alpha\) forest (black; Rogers et al. 614 ). LSS limits from CMB data are shown in brown [ 309 ] . IDM mass limits from Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) are shown by the vertical gray shaded region [ 404 , 35 ] . Filled gray contours show direct detection and X-ray Quantum Calorimeter (XQC) bounds [ 451 , 250 , 18 ] , and unfilled gray contours show cosmic ray up-scattering constraints (e.g., Alvey et al. 27 ). Adapted from Drlica-Wagner et al. [ 230 ] .
figures.caption_zh: 图5：速度无关的DM-核子散射截面作为DM粒子质量函数的代表性约束。小尺度结构的上限以金色阴影区域显示，包括高红移星系（紫色；Lazare等人413）、矮星系（蓝色；Nadler等人521）和莱曼α森林（黑色；Rogers等人614）的限制。CMB数据的LSS限制以棕色显示[309]。大爆炸核合成（BBN）的IDM质量限制以垂直灰色阴影区域显示[404, 35]。填充灰色轮廓显示直接探测和X射线量子量热计（XQC）界限[451, 250, 18]，未填充灰色轮廓显示宇宙射线升散射约束（例如，Alvey等人27）。改编自Drlica-Wagner等人[230]。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Effective SIDM cross section as a function of halo maximum circular velocity. Horizontal lines show velocity and halo mass ranges corresponding to the small-scale structure probes from Figure 1 . Approximate cross section upper limits from clusters are shaded gray, and the velocity range probed by dark halos is shaded green. Solid lines show models motivated by observations of dwarf galaxies (blue; Correa 169 ), strong-lensing substructure (red; Nadler et al. 519 ), and Little Red Dots (purple; Jiang et al. 366 ).
figures.caption_zh: 图6：有效SIDM截面作为晕最大圆周速度的函数。水平线显示图1中小尺度结构探针对应的速度和晕质量范围。来自星团的近似截面上限以灰色阴影显示，暗晕探测的速度范围以绿色阴影显示。实线显示由矮星系观测（蓝色；Correa 169）、强透镜次结构（红色；Nadler等人519）和Little Red Dots（紫色；Jiang等人366）启发的模型。

title: Bipolar HII regions Produced by Cloud-Cloud Collisions
comment: 18 pages, 13 figures, 1 table, submitted to MNRAS
summary: We use numerical experiments to explore two possibilities: (i) that Bipolar H II Regions are the result of Cloud-Cloud Collisions (CCCs), and (ii) that -- when allowance is made for the chaotic nature of such collisions, the short duration of the bipolar phase, and different viewing angles -- a large proportion of all H II Regions might be the aftermath of CCCs. To reduce the parameter space, our experiments only consider head-on collisions between two $500$ M$_\odot$ clouds, with three different levels of turbulence, and two different collision velocities; the collision velocities define the `collision axis'. In all experiments, OB stars only condense out after a Shock-Compressed Layer has formed (perpendicular to the collision axis), and fragmented to produce a Hub Filament System, with the OB stars forming in the Hub. Ionising radiation from the OB stars excites an H II Region, which tends to expand more rapidly in directions close to the collision axis, and more slowly in directions orthogonal to the collision axis, where it encounters the dense gas of the Shock-Compressed Layer. Consequently, the H II Region may appear bipolar, for a short period during its evolution, if observed at sufficiently large angle to the collision axis. Viewed from smaller angles, the waist appears as a Bright-Rim, similar to conventional approximately spherical H II Regions. Under this circumstance, there are other metrics -- based on the extent of diffuse freefree emission, the velocity dispersion of Radio Recombination Lines, dust emission at mid-infrared wavelengths -- that might indicate the aftermath of a CCC, and establish CCCs as a dominant trigger for high-mass star formation.

AI.tldr: 通过数值实验探究双极H II区是否由云-云碰撞（CCCs）形成，并评估大量H II区可能是CCC后遗症的可能性。
AI.motivation: 探索双极H II区的形成机制，检验云-云碰撞假说，并评估CCC是否是高质量恒星形成的主要触发因素。
AI.method: 数值实验仅考虑两个500 M☉云之间的对头碰撞，设置三种不同湍流水平和两种不同碰撞速度，追踪OB恒星在激波压缩层碎裂形成的Hub-丝状系统中诞生，以及电离辐射激发H II区的演化过程。
AI.result: OB恒星只在激波压缩层形成并碎裂后凝聚出来；H II区沿碰撞轴方向膨胀更快，垂直方向受稠密气体阻挡而膨胀较慢，因此在特定观测角度下呈现双极形态，而较小角度观测则表现为亮缘结构。
AI.conclusion: 双极H II区可能只是CCC后短暂演化阶段的表现，大量看似普通球形的H II区可能也是CCC的后遗症；可通过弥散自由-自由辐射、射电复合线速度弥散和中红外尘埃辐射等指标识别CCC痕迹，确立CCC作为高质量恒星形成的主要触发机制。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们通过数值实验探讨两种可能性：（i）双极H II区是云-云碰撞（CCCs）的结果；（ii）当考虑到此类碰撞的混沌性质、双极阶段的短暂持续时间以及不同的观测角度时，很大比例的H II区可能是CCCs的后续产物。为缩减参数空间，我们的实验仅考虑两个500 M$_\odot$云之间的正碰，具有三种不同的湍流水平和两种不同的碰撞速度；碰撞速度定义了“碰撞轴”。在所有实验中，OB恒星仅在激波压缩层（垂直于碰撞轴）形成并碎裂产生Hub-丝状系统后凝聚形成，OB恒星在Hub中形成。OB恒星的电离辐射激发H II区，该区域在接近碰撞轴的方向上膨胀更快，而在垂直于碰撞轴的方向上膨胀较慢，因为后者遇到激波压缩层的致密气体。因此，H II区在其演化过程中的短时间内，若以足够大的角度观测碰撞轴，可能呈现双极形态。从较小角度观测时，腰部表现为亮脊，类似于常规的近似球形H II区。在这种情况下，还有其他指标——基于弥散自由-自由辐射的范围、射电复合线的速度弥散、中红外波段的尘埃辐射——可能指示CCCs的后续影响，并确立CCCs作为高质量恒星形成的主要触发机制。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的AI结论：双极H II区可能只是CCC后短暂演化阶段的表现，大量看似普通球形的H II区可能也是CCC的后遗症；可通过弥散自由-自由辐射、射电复合线速度弥散和中红外尘埃辐射等指标识别CCC痕迹，确立CCC作为高质量恒星形成的主要触发机制。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Parameters describing the initial conditions.
figures.caption_zh: 表1：描述初始条件的参数。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: False-colour column-density maps for two CCCs, both with sonic internal turbulence ( \(\mathcal{M}\!=\!1\) ). The top six panels (a to f) represent a low-velocity collision ( \(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\) ), and the bottom six panels ( g to l ) represent a high-velocity collision ( \(2u_{o}\!=\!4.0\,{km\,s^{-1}}\) ). Within each velocity group, the upper row (rows 1 and 3; panels (a to c) , and (g to i) ) shows the projection onto the \(xy\) -plane (i.e. looking at the Shock-Compressed Layer edge-on, viewing angle \(\theta\!=\!90^{\circ}\) ), and the lower row (rows 2 and 4; panels (d to f) , and (j to l) ) shows the projection onto the \(yz\) plane (i.e. looking at the Shock-Compressed Layer face-on, viewing angle \(\theta\!=\!0^{\circ}\) ). From left to right, the columns represent the time when \(10\%\) of the total cloud mass has been assimilated by sinks (lefthand column); the time when the first OB star is formed (middle column); and the time \(50\,{kyr}\) after the formation of the first OB-type star (righthand column). The values of \(2u_{o}\) , \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\) , \(t\) and \(\theta\) are given at the top of each panel. The column-density scale is logarithmic. Red dots mark the positions of sink particles.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：两个CCC的假彩色柱密度图，两者均具有声速内部湍流（\(\mathcal{M}\!=\!1\)）。顶部六个面板（a至f）表示低速碰撞（\(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\)），底部六个面板（g至l）表示高速碰撞（\(2u_{o}\!=\!4.0\,{km\,s^{-1}}\)）。在每个速度组内，上行（第1行和第3行；面板（a至c）和（g至i））显示在\(xy\)平面上的投影（即从侧面观察激波压缩层，视角\(\theta\!=\!90^{\circ}\)），下行（第2行和第4行；面板（d至f）和（j至l））显示在\(yz\)平面上的投影（即从正面观察激波压缩层，视角\(\theta\!=\!0^{\circ}\)）。从左到右，各列分别表示总云质量的\(10\%\)被汇吸收的时刻（左列）；第一颗OB恒星形成的时刻（中列）；以及第一颗OB型恒星形成后\(50\,{kyr}\)的时刻（右列）。每个面板顶部给出了\(2u_{o}\)、\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\)、\(t\)和\(\theta\)的值。柱密度标度为对数。红点标记汇粒子的位置。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: As Figure 1 but for clouds with hypersonic internal turbulence ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\) ).
figures.caption_zh: 图2：同图1，但云具有高超声速内部湍流（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\)）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: The total mass in stars as a function of time for all setups. Blue curves represent low-velocity collisions ( \(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\) ), and red curves represent high-velocity collisions ( \(2u_{o}\!=\!4.0\,{km\,s^{-1}}\) ). Full lines are for clouds with sonic turbulence ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\) ), dash-dotted lines are for clouds with supersonic turbulence ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!3\) ), and dashed lines are for clouds with hypersonic turbulence ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\) ). Each line gives the mean of two random realisations.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：所有设置中恒星总质量随时间的变化。蓝线表示低速碰撞（\(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\)），红线表示高速碰撞（\(2u_{o}\!=\!4.0\,{km\,s^{-1}}\)）。实线表示声速湍流（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\)）的云，点划线表示超声速湍流（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!3\)）的云，虚线表示高超声速湍流（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\)）的云。每条线是两个随机实现的平均值。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: False-colour maps of the emission measure for setups with sonic turbulence ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\) ). The top six panels ((a) to (f) ) represent a low-velocity collision ( \(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\) ), and the bottom six panels ((g) to (l) ) represent a high-velocity collision ( \(2u_{o}\!=\!4.0\,{km\,s^{-1}}\) ). Within each velocity group, the upper row (rows 1 and 3; panels (a) to (c) , and (g) to (i) ) shows the projection onto the \(xy\) -plane (i.e. looking at the Shock-Compressed Layer edge-on, viewing angle \(\theta\!=\!90^{\circ}\) ), and the lower row (rows 2 and 4; panels (d) to (f) , and (j) to (l) ) shows the projection onto the \(yz\) plane (i.e. looking at the Shock-Compressed Layer face-on, viewing angle \(\theta\!=\!0^{\circ}\) ). From left to right, the three columns represent a time-sequence at \(t_{\mbox{\tiny OB}}\!=\!0.05\,{Myr}\) , \(\;0.10\,{Myr}\,\) and \(\;0.15\,{Myr}\,\) after formation of the first OB-type star. The values of \(2u_{o}\) , \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\) , \(t_{\mbox{\tiny OB}}\) and \(\theta\) are given at the top of each panel. As is standard practice, the Emission Measure is given in \({cm^{-6}\,pc}\) , and is scaled logarithmically. Red dots mark the locations of sink particles.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：声速湍流（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\)）设置的发射测量假彩色图。顶部六个面板（（a）至（f））表示低速碰撞（\(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\)），底部六个面板（（g）至（l））表示高速碰撞（\(2u_{o}\!=\!4.0\,{km\,s^{-1}}\)）。在每个速度组内，上行（第1行和第3行；面板（a）至（c）和（g）至（i））显示在\(xy\)平面上的投影（即从侧面观察激波压缩层，视角\(\theta\!=\!90^{\circ}\)），下行（第2行和第4行；面板（d）至（f）和（j）至（l））显示在\(yz\)平面上的投影（即从正面观察激波压缩层，视角\(\theta\!=\!0^{\circ}\)）。从左到右，三列表示第一颗OB型恒星形成后\(t_{\mbox{\tiny OB}}\!=\!0.05\,{Myr}\)、\(\;0.10\,{Myr}\,\)和\(\;0.15\,{Myr}\,\)的时间序列。每个面板顶部给出了\(2u_{o}\)、\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\)、\(t_{\mbox{\tiny OB}}\)和\(\theta\)的值。按照标准做法，发射测量以\({cm^{-6}\,pc}\)为单位，并以对数标度。红点标记汇粒子的位置。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: The waist radius ( \(R_{\mbox{\tiny W}}\) ) as a function of time since formation of the first OB star ( \(t_{\mbox{\tiny OB}}\) ). Red curves represent high-velocity collisions and blue curves represent low-velocity collisions. Solid, dash-dotted and dashed lines represent, respectively, setups with sonic ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\) ), supersonic ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!3\) ), and hypersonic ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\) ) turbulence. Each curve is the mean of two realisations.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：腰部半径（\(R_{\mbox{\tiny W}}\)）作为第一颗OB恒星形成以来时间（\(t_{\mbox{\tiny OB}}\)）的函数。红线表示高速碰撞，蓝线表示低速碰撞。实线、点划线和虚线分别表示声速（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\)）、超声速（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!3\)）和高超声速（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\)）湍流的设置。每条曲线是两个实现的平均值。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Top row : false-colour maps of Emission-Measure for a low-velocity collision ( \(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\) ) with sonic turbulence in the pre-collision clouds ( \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\) ), at \(t_{{OB}}=0.15\) Myr, from four different viewing angles: (a) \(\theta\!=\!90^{\circ}\) ; (b) \(\theta\!=\!75^{\circ}\) ; (c) \(\theta\!=\!60^{\circ}\) ; (d) \(\theta\!=\!30^{\circ}\) . Bottom row : maps of the the corresponding Emission-Measure weighted mean line-of-sight velocity, \(\mu_{v}\) . The value of \(\theta\) is given at the top of each panel.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：顶行：低速碰撞（\(2u_{o}\!=\!2.4\,{km\,s^{-1}}\)）且碰撞前云具有声速湍流（\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\)）的发射测量假彩色图，在\(t_{{OB}}=0.15\) Myr时，从四个不同视角观测：（a）\(\theta\!=\!90^{\circ}\)；（b）\(\theta\!=\!75^{\circ}\)；（c）\(\theta\!=\!60^{\circ}\)；（d）\(\theta\!=\!30^{\circ}\)。底行：相应的发射测量加权平均视线速度\(\mu_{v}\)的图。每个面板顶部给出了\(\theta\)的值。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: As Figure 6 , but with hypersonic turbulence, \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\) , in the pre-collision clouds (rather than sonic turbulence, \(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\) ).
figures.caption_zh: 图7：同图6，但碰撞前云具有高超声速湍流，\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!6\)（而非声速湍流，\(\mathcal{\bar{M}}\!=\!1\)）。
